       becomes probable that an outflow of future                    能需要就一項先前作為或有
       economic benefits will be required for an item                負債處理之項目付出未來經
       previously dealt with as a contingent liability,              濟 利 益，則 於 可 能 出 現 變 動 之
       a provision is recognised in the consolidated                 報告期間之綜合財務報表內
       financial statements in the reporting period in               確 認 撥 備，惟 在 不 能 作 出 可 靠
